title: Barber's team saw the same octagonal 'eight-gon' craft that Herrera described

tellings.quote: Well, interestingly enough, this particular craft, the eight at eight gone, is exactly what Michael Herrera reports to have seen.

plain: In 2023, according to Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he took part in recovering a UFO, his team saw an eight-sided craft he calls an "eight-gon". Barber says it is exactly the craft that another witness, a man named Michael Herrera, says he saw, which to Barber means two separate accounts point to the same object.
